it: \bCome ha fatto qualcuno a trovarci qui?

id: \bRiley: Welcome to Iron Island. You must be a powerful Trainer to be here right now. Let me see what you've got.
en: \bRiley: Welcome to Iron Island. You must be a powerful Trainer to be here right now. Let me see what you've got.
it: \bMarisio: Benvenuto sull'Isola Ferrosa. Devi essere un Allenatore molto forte per trovarti qui proprio adesso. Fammi vedere cosa sai fare.

id: \bWhat a strong Trainer. You deserve this.
en: \bWhat a strong Trainer. You deserve this.

id: \bYou might be strong enough to help me, actually. The aura in the area is messed up. I think someone is behind it.
en: \bYou might be strong enough to help me, actually.  The aura in the area is messed up. I think someone is behind it.
it: \bA dire il vero, potresti essere abbastanza forte da aiutarmi. L'aura in questa zona è sconvolta. Credo che qualcuno ci sia dietro.

id: \bLucario and I have to focus on keeping the aura at bay. Talk to me when you're ready and I'll let you into the cave to find the source of the problem.
en: \bLucario and I have to focus on keeping the aura at bay. Talk to me when you're ready and I'll let you into the cave to find the source of the problem.
it: \bIo e Lucario dobbiamo concentrarci per tenere a bada l'aura. Parlami quando sei pronto e ti farò entrare nella grotta per trovare l'origine del problema.

id: \bRiley: I'll let you through the cave.
en: \bRiley: I'll let you through the cave.

id: \bRiley: For beating me I would like to offer you this egg.
en: \bRiley: For beating me I would like to offer you this egg.
it: \bMarzio: Per avermi battuto, vorrei offrirti quest'Uovo.

id: \bOh, you can't carry it with you.
en: \bOh, you can't carry it with you.

id: \bMake some space in your party and come back.
en: \bMake some space in your party and come back.
it: \bFai un po' di posto nella tua squadra e torna.

id: \bOh. I guess I'll hold onto it for now.
en: \bOh. I guess I'll hold onto it for now.
it: \bOh. Allora credo che lo terrò io per ora.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?

id: \rMars: No, we only scanned 60%. I can't pull out yet. But I don't stand a chance right now.
en: \rMars: No, we only scanned 60%. I can't pull out yet.  But I don't stand a chance right now.
it: \rMartes: No, abbiamo scansionato solo il 60%. Non posso ritirarmi ora.  Ma adesso non ho nessuna possibilità.

id: \rIt will be fine. We can find the Spear Pillar with just that. Grunts, retreat!
en: \rIt will be fine. We can find the Spear Pillar with just that. Grunts, retreat!
it: \rAndrà bene. Possiamo trovare la Vetta Lancia anche solo con questo. Reclute, ritirata!
